description: Passing the exam that decides the next ten years. The specific pleasure is the click, and it is disproportionate to the size of what was understood.
energy_note: The thing that was opaque, suddenly is not.

description: The weeks before it are their own good thing. Kumar, Killingsworth and Gilovich found anticipation of an experience is pleasurable in itself and, notably, unrelated to what it cost.
energy_note: The waiting is part of the thing, not a delay before it.
notes: Waiting for Merlot: anticipatory consumption of experiential and material purchases.

description: Almost every account of an educational good involves one specific adult who formed a view. The teaching matters; being believed in matters at least as much.
energy_note: One person who thought you could do it.

description: An institution that is open, staffed, unstruck, affordable and willing to register you - plus documents proving you are who you say. This is the single densest collision point with the hurdle datasets.
energy_note: A working institution, which is not guaranteed.
notes: Pairs with EDU categories in assets/text/{nigeria,palestine,iran}: strikes, raids, closures, credential recognition and the certificate nobody abroad trusts.

description: Passing the exam that decides the next ten years stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.
energy_note: It turns into the story about it.
notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
